name: SF0 v-next.13 - Planner (clarify gate + NC-2 gates)

content.content:
## SF0 v-next.12 — Planner (clarify gate: claim lookup -> clarify gate -> claim -> planner; bands bind size_fit deterministically)
Form/business answers in -> ONE planner LLM call (decision tier via registry) -> deterministic validator (registry-driven) -> ONLY valid drafts saved as search_profiles status=draft with a code-rendered summary + hashes. Approve mode: owner actor only, re-validates, registry + summary hash bound. Wonder agent-layer v2.2 READY TO BUILD; R1-R7 are build-exit gates. NO activation path except the approve operation.

parameters.query: SELECT (value = encode(sha256(convert_to($1, 'UTF8')), 'hex')) AS key_ok FROM sf0_config WHERE key = 'owner_key_hash'

parameters.jsCode: const row = $('Check Key').first().json || {}; const route = $('Route').first().json; return [{json: Object.assign({}, route, {key_ok: row.key_ok === true})}];

parameters.query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cost_ledger WHERE idempotency_key = $1) AS has_claim

parameters.jsCode: const row = $('Claim Lookup').first().json || {}; const route = $('Route').first().json; return [{json: Object.assign({}, route, {has_claim: row.has_claim === true})}];

const BRIEF = "LEAD FINDER — PLANNER ARCHITECTURE BRIEF (registry v1.0.0)
You design a search profile for a deterministic lead-finding pipeline. Stages: discovery (per source below) -> dedupe -> deterministic scoring + bounded judge -> evidence research -> contact finding -> human approval sheet. You output ONLY the profile JSON.
SOURCES (only these types):
- apify_maps: grammar: category AND canonical_location; max 12 queries
- tavily_research: grammar: free query built from allowlisted tokens, must contain a location token; max 6 queries
- tavily_social: grammar: category queries per platform (facebook, tiktok); location from profile; max 12 queries; platforms ['facebook', 'tiktok']
RESEARCH FIELDS (only these): business_type, company_type, industry, category, description, business_description, business_areas, business_model, products, product_category, services, offering, address, headquarters, location, website, facebook_page, messenger_usage, order_channels, review_count, rating, company_size, owner_involvement, pain_points
SIZE BANDS: solo, micro_2_5, small_6_20, medium_21_50, large_50p
DETERMINISTIC RUBRIC CHECKS (machine_check must be one of these ids; anything judgement-based must be kind research_only):
- location_match (required params: none)
- business_type_match (required params: none)
- facebook_linkage (required params: none)
- review_volume (required params: min_reviews)
- size_fit (required params: none)
RUBRIC LIMITS: total points <= 70, research_only (judge) points <= 30, per criterion <= 15.
KNOWN LOCATIONS: Yangon, Mandalay, Bangkok. KNOWN CATEGORIES: clothing store, beauty salon, cosmetics shop, restaurant, cafe, mobile phone shop, furniture store, electronics store, boutique hotel, serviced apartment, small resort, hotel, spa, bakery, pharmacy, gym.
RULES: use only words from the business answers, the locations/categories above; never invent places, categories, numbers or URLs; every input location and exclusion must appear in the profile; maps queries are '<category> <location>'; every query within one source must be unique, never repeat a query; if the business type is not a known category, use the closest known category for maps queries; output strict JSON with keys business_context, profile, rubric only.
OUTPUT SCHEMA (exact keys, no others): {business_context:{business_name, locations[], exclusions[], notes}, profile:{sources: ARRAY of {source: 'apify_maps'|'tavily_research'|'tavily_social', locations[], queries[] (tavily_social also platforms[] AND enabled: true|false — the key is named source, never type)}, lead_unit:'company', hard_filters[], decision_maker_titles[], research_fields[], size_fit:{ideal_bands[]}, outreach_angles[], exclusions[]}, rubric: OBJECT {fit_criteria: ARRAY of {name, max_points, kind: 'deterministic'|'research_only', machine_check (deterministic only), params{}, how_to_verify}, timing_triggers: ARRAY of {name, max_points, signal, decay_days}, llm_judgement_max: 30, bands: {A: 75, B: 55, C: 36}} — fit_criteria max_points MUST sum to exactly 70}.
RUBRIC NAMING (the scoring engine dispatches on criterion NAMES — follow exactly): location_match criteria: name contains 'location'. business_type_match: name contains 'business type' AND how_to_verify is exactly 'Company category matches any of: term1, term2, term3' listing the target business types. facebook_linkage: name contains 'facebook'. review_volume: name contains 'review' and 'count'. size_fit: name contains 'size'. Rubric entries may include how_to_verify (required for business_type_match).";

' + JSON.stringify(inputs) + '

Return ONLY the profile JSON.'}]};
return [{json:{payload}}];

INSERT INTO sf0_attempts (idem, actor, mode, outcome, detail) VALUES ($1, $2, 'plan', $3, $4::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (idem) DO UPDATE SET outcome = EXCLUDED.outcome, detail = EXCLUDED.detail WHERE sf0_attempts.outcome IN ('needs_input','pre_llm_rejected') RETURNING idem
